plan.title: Factory shared agentic toolchain
plan.goal: Expose a reproducible, Nix-store-shared development-tool baseline without vendoring payloads into provisioned projects or activating a host by default.

phases.name: ST-1 — inert Nix module and installer contract
phases.goal: Default-off module, installer catalog/fieldset projection, and bound execution evidence.

phases.name: ST-2 — aq-tool live on-demand runtime reach
phases.goal: Live, mid-session reach to any package in pinned nixpkgs with no restart and no manifest gate.

phases.name: ST-3 — capability manifest declaration and readiness check
phases.goal: Manifest as declaration/record (append-live), + readiness WARN on declared-but-missing tools; manifest never gates runtime access.

phases.name: ST-4 — governed contribute-back flow
phases.goal: Governed workflow to contribute durable, pinned tools back to the shared toolchain via capability-intake and flake-review.

phases.name: Owner-gated activation
phases.goal: A separate owner act may enable the role and rebuild a chosen host.

items.name: Default-off shared toolchain installer projection
items.goal: Project only roles.agenticToolchain.enable and keep every host inactive.
items.validation_goal: Catalog, fieldset, resolver, and execution-MAC contracts pass; Nix evaluation remains build-only.

commit_match: declare the default-off shared agent toolchain role

acceptance.note: Committed in de84c9e3 and 6d2a624c; inert default-off role declared and tested.

items.name: ST-2 — aq-tool live on-demand runtime reach
items.goal: Live on-demand tool reach from pinned nixpkgs without restart or manifest gate.
items.validation_goal: scripts/testing/test-aq-tool.py passes; forwards stdout/stderr and exits cleanly.

items.name: ST-3 — capability manifest declaration/record and readiness check
items.goal: Capability manifest as declaration/record (append-live) + readiness WARN on declared-but-missing tools; manifest never gates runtime access.
items.validation_goal: scripts/testing/test-aq-capabilities.py passes; declares tools, checks PATH and aq-tool reachability without blocking.

acceptance.note: Manifest declaration, list, add, check, overview verified by test-aq-capabilities.py

items.name: ST-4 — governed contribute-back flow
items.goal: Vetted contribute-back workflow via capability-intake + flake-review at FT-6 tier to pin tools fleet-wide.

acceptance.note: Governed contribute-back workflow implemented in aq-capabilities contribute and verified by test-aq-capabilities.py

items.name: Enable selected host and rebuild
items.goal: Set mySystem.roles.agenticToolchain.enable = true only after explicit owner approval.
items.validation_goal: Owner-selected build/switch plus runtime tool-path evidence.

acceptance.note: Owner activation confirmed. Runtime tools on PATH: /run/current-system/sw/bin/tmux, /run/current-system/sw/bin/watch, PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/nix/store/...-playwright-browsers, PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1.
